question: b3 (0x005C1390 ??_GCItem@NInventory@@QAEPAXI@Z): may the self line land when it makes pk_all resolve other rows' existing, unchanged pick-any ??_GCItem copies to 0x005C1390 as NEQ, one of them reached from its leaf?

Unreached: 0x005BF91A (28 B) and 0x00621A20 (30 B) NOADDR -> NEQ, reach n (evidence/pkcensus_v1.tsv). No bytes change in any of them. (4) Probe (evidence/probe_005bf969_implicit_dtor.txt): 0x005BF969 with the implicit-dtor opt-in keeps its leaf RELOCATION_MATCH, but its copy is 34 B. It is framed (push ebp / mov ebp,esp; flag at [ebp+8]) because that row's TU is #pragma optimize("y", off), so no CItem model makes that copy EQ: retail's own copy in a frame-pointer TU would also have differed from the linked body. proposal: ACCEPT b3 and book a debt line for the four definers' copies (the 0x005C1ECC copy is already NEQ and reached at HEAD; 0x005BF969 / 0x005BF91A / 0x00621A20 only gain an address). Queue the implicit-dtor opt-in for the two frameless definers 0x005BF91A and 0x00621A20 as T3 (objdump: push esi / mov esi,ecx, then a call of ??1CItem). The two framed ones, 0x005BF969 and 0x005C1ECC (both #pragma optimize("y", off); push ebp / mov ebp,esp), cannot be made EQ by any CItem model. Otherwise HOLD b3 until those rows are re-rowed.

question: b4 (0x00656EAD ??_GCQuestInfoElementCounterList@CDrawQuestInfo@NPlayerGui@@QAEPAXI@Z): is a closing `#pragma optimize("", on)` acceptable scaffolding? It sets the optimize mode of the header's template instances (taken at the end of the TU; GOTCHAS 2026-11-24) so that the pick-any ~vector<CEnginePrimitiveHandle> copy is EQ at its bound address, while the row's own ??_G keeps its size-mode body.
evidence: Whole-TU size form (`#pragma optimize("s",on)` only): leaf RELOCATION_MATCH, but ~vector is a 30-byte size-mode body, NEQ at 0x00440C40 and reached from the leaf (pk_all reach y), with no identical copy in any landed object (defscan_v2: the speed copies of 0x0072DB90 / 0x0072DBE0 are 50 B). deallocate is likewise unique (20 B). With the closing pragma (evidence/pA.cpp = the row): leaf unchanged (RELOCATION_MATCH, same 31 B), ~vector EQ at 0x00440C40, and every other chain COMDAT TIER1 v 0x0072DB90 / 0x0072DBE0 / 0x004A3740 (scan_v2.tsv). ~CQuestInfoElement and ~CQuestInfoElementCounterList (8 B, exact FableWin names, no other definer) match four unreferenced, off-catalog retail stubs `add ecx,10h ; jmp 0x00440C40` (0x006567BB, 0x006568A3, 0x006568AB, 0x006568B3; R1: a non-unique home, no address recorded). The nearest ruling is nf398 (size-pragma scaffolding may change a compiler-generated callee when its new copy is EQ at its bound address), but that ruling covers a wrapped header opt-in, not a TU-end reset.
proposal: ACCEPT b4 with the closing pragma (Fidelity: scaffolding line in the row), as the nf398 extension applied in the speed direction: the changed copy is EQ at its bound address and the leaf does not change.
